name: RFC 6749 - The OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework
notes: Framework vocabulary and the token/authorization endpoints exercised by the KYM sandbox authorization server. Sandbox only; not a certified or complete OAuth server. Interoperability not tested.

name: RFC 7636 - Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE)
notes: PKCE implemented in the sandbox authorization server. Not interoperability tested.

name: RFC 7009 - OAuth 2.0 Token Revocation
notes: Revocation endpoint implemented in the sandbox authorization server. KYM additionally checks mandate revocation on every request regardless of token validity.

name: RFC 7662 - OAuth 2.0 Token Introspection
notes: Introspection endpoint implemented in the sandbox authorization server.

name: RFC 8693 - OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange
notes: Simulated sandbox adapter using the act (actor) claim to represent delegation. Not a complete token exchange implementation.

name: RFC 8705 - OAuth 2.0 Mutual-TLS Client Authentication and Certificate-Bound Access Tokens
notes: Conceptually mapped only. The demo uses DPoP (RFC 9449) sender-constraint and has no mTLS.

name: RFC 8707 - Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0
notes: Implemented as an audience (aud) check on access tokens. Full resource indicator parameter behaviour is not claimed.

name: RFC 8785 - JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS)
notes: Used via the rfc8785 library to canonicalize payloads before hashing for ledger entries and mandate digests.

name: RFC 9068 - JSON Web Token (JWT) Profile for OAuth 2.0 Access Tokens
notes: Access tokens are real signed JWTs (PyJWT, Ed25519/ES256) with RFC 9068-style claims, issued by the sandbox authorization server. Not a certified server.

name: RFC 9126 - OAuth 2.0 Pushed Authorization Requests (PAR)
notes: Simulated sandbox adapter.

name: RFC 9396 - OAuth 2.0 Rich Authorization Requests (RAR)
notes: authorization_details parsing and validation implemented in the sandbox authorization server, including the KYM experimental kym_financial_mandate type.

name: RFC 9449 - OAuth 2.0 Demonstrating Proof of Possession (DPoP)
notes: DPoP proof validation implemented in the sandbox authorization server: cnf.jkt binding; htm, htu, iat, ath checks; jti replay detection.

name: RFC 9700 - Best Current Practice for OAuth 2.0 Security
notes: Used as design guidance (sender-constrained tokens, PKCE, audience restriction). Conformance has not been assessed.

name: OpenID Connect Core 1.0
notes: Conceptually mapped (customer authentication, ID token). The demo uses a simulated bank-authenticated session instead.

name: FAPI 2.0 Security Profile
notes: Final specification (published 2025-02-22 per the document header). KYM reuses building blocks (PKCE, DPoP, PAR simulated) but does not claim FAPI 2.0 conformance or certification.

name: Grant Management for OAuth 2.0
notes: The former FAPI Grant Management URL now states the specification was renamed to oauth-v2-grant-management; the page title shows 'Draft'. Conceptual mapping to KYM grant and mandate lifecycle only.

name: OpenID Shared Signals Framework (SSF) 1.0
notes: Conceptual mapping for propagating revocation and risk signals. No SSF transmitter or receiver implemented.

name: OpenID Continuous Access Evaluation Profile (CAEP) 1.0
notes: Conceptual mapping to KYM per-request revocation and risk re-evaluation. No CAEP events are emitted.

name: RDF 1.1 Concepts and Abstract Syntax
notes: KYM ontology and graph data are handled with rdflib. An RDF 1.2 Concepts page also exists at w3.org/TR/rdf12-concepts/; its maturity was not checked.

name: OWL 2 Web Ontology Language
notes: KYM ontology vocabulary is authored; no OWL reasoner is used for authorization decisions.

name: JSON-LD 1.1
notes: JSON-LD contexts and serialization via rdflib.

name: Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL)
notes: Validation via pySHACL.

name: ODRL Information Model 2.2
notes: ODRL terms are reused in the KYM ontology. No ODRL policy engine is used and ODRL profile conformance is not claimed.

name: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
notes: PROV-O terms are reused to describe provenance of decisions and evidence.

name: Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0
notes: Conceptual mapping only: the KYM mandate is a signed JWT, not a Verifiable Credential.

name: Financial Data Exchange (FDX) API
notes: Conceptual mapping of data-access scopes only. The specification itself was not reviewed in detail and FDX membership/licensing terms are not assessed.

name: Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
notes: Version v0.2.0 (tagged 2026-04-28) observed. Conceptual mapping only; see docs/research/ap2-mapping.md. KYM does not implement AP2 messages or SD-JWT mandates.

name: Visa Intelligent Commerce
notes: Developer documentation page confirmed reachable; specification contents not reviewed in detail. Conceptual mapping only.

name: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol
notes: Public repository confirmed reachable; contents not reviewed in detail. Conceptual mapping only.

name: Mastercard Agent Pay
notes: Product page confirmed reachable; technical specification contents not reviewed. Conceptual mapping only.

name: Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)
notes: Public repository confirmed reachable (also https://www.agenticcommerce.dev/); contents not reviewed in detail. Conceptual mapping only.

name: x402 payments protocol
notes: Described by its repository as a payments protocol built on HTTP. Conceptual mapping only.

name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
notes: KYM exposes a restricted tool interface sandbox with a tool-list shape modelled on MCP. Discovery is not permission: listing a tool grants no authority. Not tested against real MCP clients. The 'latest' URL resolved to the 2026-07-28 specification revision on 2026-11-26.

name: Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol
notes: The specification page lists 1.0.0 as the latest released version. Conceptual mapping only.

name: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English
body: ASD (AeroSpace and Defence Industries Association of Europe)
notes: Referenced as inspiration for controlled-language principles. KYM-CNL does not claim ASD-STE100 conformance.

name: SPIFFE / SPIRE
notes: Not used. Demo keys stored in local files; real deployments could use SPIFFE IDs and SVIDs for agent workload identity.

name: Open Policy Agent (OPA)
notes: Not used. KYM uses a typed Python policy engine; a conceptual mapping is documented.

name: Cedar policy language
notes: Not used. KYM uses a typed Python policy engine; a conceptual mapping is documented.

name: NIST SP 800-63-4 Digital Identity Guidelines
notes: Conceptual reference for authenticator assurance of the customer approving mandates. The demo uses a simulated session, not passkeys; no assurance level is claimed.

name: NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture
notes: Conceptual alignment: deny-by-default policy decision point with per-request evaluation.

name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
notes: Conceptual reference only. No AI RMF assessment performed.

name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 (and Agentic AI - Threats and Mitigations)
notes: Referenced in the threat model by item name. Earlier guide: https://genai.owasp.org/resource/agentic-ai-threats-and-mitigations/ (dated 2025-02-17).

name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
notes: The 2025 edition item names (e.g. LLM01 Prompt Injection, LLM06 Excessive Agency) were verified on this page; a 2026 edition with different numbering also exists. Referenced in the threat model.

name: OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023)
notes: Referenced in the threat model by item name (e.g. API1 Broken Object Level Authorization, API5 Broken Function Level Authorization).

name: Microsoft Entra Agent ID
notes: Conceptual reference for non-human agent identities. Not used.

name: Microsoft Entra Workload ID
notes: Conceptual reference for workload identities. Not used.

name: AWS Security Token Service (STS) and IAM OIDC federation
notes: Conceptual reference for short-lived credentials. OIDC federation page: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_providers_oidc.html. Not used.

name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity
notes: Vendor documentation on identity and credential management for agent applications. Conceptual reference only; not used.

name: Google Cloud Workload Identity Federation
notes: Conceptual reference for external workload identity without long-lived keys. Not used.

name: Google Cloud Agent Identity
notes: Vendor documentation page 'Agent Identity overview'. Conceptual reference only; not used.

name: RFC 3161 - Time-Stamp Protocol (TSP)
notes: Production-hardening option for externally timestamping evidence ledger checkpoints. Not implemented.

name: RFC 6962 - Certificate Transparency
notes: Reference for Merkle-tree transparency logs, a production-hardening option for the evidence ledger. Not implemented.

name: KYM kym_financial_mandate RAR authorization_details type
notes: Experimental extension. The RFC 9396 authorization_details type 'kym_financial_mandate' carries mandate constraints. The URL is a non-resolving placeholder namespace; not registered or standardized.

name: KYM mandate JWT claims (https://example.org/kym/mandate_id etc.)
notes: Experimental private claims added to access tokens for mandate binding, using URL-style names under the non-resolving example.org namespace. Not registered with IANA.

name: KYM ontology v1
notes: Authored vocabulary reusing PROV-O and ODRL terms; non-resolving placeholder namespace. No reasoner is used for authorization.

name: KYM-CNL (controlled natural language)
notes: Experimental controlled language for expressing mandates in readable form. Placeholder URL; no external standard conformance claimed (see ASD-STE100 note).

name: KYM Evidence Ledger
notes: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained evidence ledger with signed checkpoints over RFC 8785 canonical JSON. Demo keys in local files; no external witness, timestamping or WORM storage. Placeholder URL.
